title: BackdoorVLM: A Benchmark for Backdoor Attacks on Vision-Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the security and robustness of Vision-Language Models against backdoor attacks. While one of the attack targets is 'jailbreak' (which involves bypassing safety filters), the benchmark is designed to evaluate the technical vulnerability of the models to malicious triggers rather than to evaluate or benchmark the model's religious, moral, or ethical reasoning capabilities.
